sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER TROUGH OVER THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS WILL ADVANCE SLOWLY EWD THROUGH THE MID/LOWER MS VALLEY THURSDAY...REACHING THE TN VALLEY THURSDAY NIGHT. ATTENDANT SURFACE LOW WILL DEVELOP NEWD INTO WRN MO BY EVENING WITH TRAILING FRONT EXTENDING SWWD THROUGH ERN OK AND NRN/CNTRL TX WHERE IT WILL LIKELY STALL. DRYLINE WILL EXTEND NWD FROM THE BIG BEND AREA OF SWRN TX AND INTERSECT THE COLD FRONT ACROSS W-CNTRL TX. THIS BOUNDARY WILL RETREAT WWD THURSDAY NIGHT. WARM FRONT WILL LIFT NWD THROUGH THE LOWER-MID MS AND TN VALLEYS.

sections.title: ERN PORTIONS OF THE SRN PLAINS THROUGH THE LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: COLD FRONT SURGING SEWD FROM WRN OK INTO THE SRN TX PANHANDLE WILL LIKELY SERVE TO INITIATE ANOTHER ROUND OF STORMS EARLY THURSDAY AS IT INTERCEPTS AXIS OF 2000+ J/KG MLCAPE IN PLACE ACROSS N-CNTRL TX AND SRN OK. THESE STORMS WILL SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE EWD THROUGH UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR AND EVENTUALLY INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY. PRIMARY LOW-LEVEL JET WILL SHIFT TOWARD THE MS/TN VALLEYS DURING THE DAY WITH WEAK BOUNDARY LAYER FLOW FARTHER WEST ACROSS TX. HOWEVER...MID-LEVEL JET ROTATING THROUGH UPPER TROUGH BASE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO 40 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR...AND THIS WILL SUPPORT A POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING BOWING SEGMENTS AND SUPERCELLS. DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS AS ACTIVITY CONTINUES EWD INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY. MCS WILL LIKELY STILL BE ONGOING OVER PORTIONS OF AR INTO WRN TN THURSDAY MORNING. STORMS WILL SHIFT SLOWLY EWD DURING THE DAY IN ASSOCIATION WITH VEERING AND WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL JET. THIS ACTIVITY WILL SERVE TO LIMIT DESTABILIZATION ACROSS MUCH OF NERN AR...SERN MO AND PORTION OF WRN TN. HOWEVER...INFLOW FROM THE DESTABILIZING WARM SECTOR MAY CONTRIBUTE TO INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS ON SRN END OF THE MCS WITH A THREAT FOR MAINLY LARGE HA

sections.title: ERN KS THROUGH WRN MO
sections.text: IN WAKE OF CONVECTIVE DEBRIS FROM MCS...THE ATMOSPHERE SHOULD DESTABILIZE IN VICINITY OF SURFACE LOW AND OCCLUDED BOUNDARY ACROSS SERN KS AND WRN MO WITH MLCAPE FROM 500-1000 J/KG POSSIBLE. COOL AIR ALOFT BENEATH THE UPPER LOW AND DIABATIC WARMING WILL SUPPORT STEEP LOW-MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. STORMS SHOULD REDEVELOP ALONG THIS BOUNDARY DURING THE AFTERNOON. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG...BUT SHOULD BE AUGMENTED SOMEWHAT WITHIN ZONE OF BACKED WINDS JUST EAST OF SURFACE LOW. ISOLATED BRIEF TORNADOES AND HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS WITH ACTIVITY DEVELOPING ALONG THE BOUNDARY AND NEAR THE SURFACE LOW. ..DIAL/GRAMS.. 05/20/2010

sections.title: SERN KS/SWRN MO
sections.text: WILL CONTINUE THE LOW PROBS OF BOTH HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES THIS REGION AS UPPER LOW MOVES ACROSS DURING AFTERNOON. THE THREAT IS CONTINGENT ON THE AMOUNT OF HEATING THAT CAN OCCUR. IF CURRENT CLOUDINESS HOLDS THEN LATER OUTLOOKS COULD REDUCE WHAT THREAT THERE IS. ..HALES/JEWELL.. 05/20/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: KS UPR LOW EXPECTED TO CONTINUE ENE INTO IA AND SLOWLY WEAKEN THIS PERIOD AS LEAD IMPULSE ASSOCIATED WITH POTENT NE PACIFIC TROUGH SWEEPS NE ACROSS THE NRN RCKYS. AT THE SFC...SE KS SFC LOW SHOULD SLOWLY FILL AS IT MOVES INTO WRN MO LATER TODAY AND TO NEAR STL EARLY FRI. WEAK WARM FRONT EXTENDING SE FROM THE LOW WILL ADVANCE NE ACROSS THE TN VLY...WHILE TRAILING COLD FRONT SETTLES SLOWLY SE ACROSS ERN OK/WRN AR AND CNTRL/ERN TX.

sections.title: CNTRL/E TX INTO THE LWR MS/LWR TN VLYS THIS AFTN AND EVE
sections.text: COLD FRONT IN CNTRL TX...AND COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ARCING FROM NE TX ACROSS NRN LA INTO ERN AR WILL BE THE MAIN FOCUS FOR DIURNALLY ENHANCED STORMS TODAY. OTHER STORMS MAY CONCENTRATE A BIT FARTHER E ALONG WARM FRONTAL SEGMENT IN ERN MS/WRN AR AND WRN TN/WRN KY. SATELLITE AND RAOB DATA SHOW A LOW AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCE...NOW OVER ERN OK/NE TX...ROTATING EWD AROUND BASE OF KS UPR LOW. THE DISTURBANCE SHOULD CONTINUE ENE THROUGH THE DAY...FURTHERING LOW LVL DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION AND ASCENT IN LA/MS/TN/KY. COMBINATION OF RELATIVELY COOL TEMPS ALOFT WITH STG SFC HEATING SHOULD YIELD SBCAPE OF 2500-3500 J/KG AHEAD OF FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM CNTRL TX ENE INTO CNTRL/NRN MS. COUPLED WITH 40-50KT DEEP WLY SHEAR...EXPECT THAT SFC-BASED STORMS LIKELY TO FORM OVER THE REGION WILL QUICKLY BECOME SVR...WITH LARGE HAIL THE MAIN THREAT FROM BOTH SUPERCELLS AND SUSTAINED MULTICELLS. AND...GIVEN RICH MOISTURE SUPPLY AND STEEP LOW LVL LAPSE RATES...ISOLD TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE A POSSIBILITY. A TORNADO OR TWO ALSO CANNOT BE RULES OUT FARTHER N/NE INTO WRN TN AND WRN KY...WHERE BACKED LOW LVL FLOW WILL EXIST INVOF WARM FRONT. WHILE MOST OF THE SVR THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH WITH SUNSET...ISOLD SV

sections.title: ERN KS/WRN MO THIS AFTN
sections.text: WILL MAINTAIN LOW PROBABILITIES FOR BOTH HAIL AND BRIEF TORNADOES IN THIS REGION AS UPR LOW MOVES IN TANDEM WITH SFC LOW. GIVEN SUFFICIENT SFC HEATING...COOLING/ASCENT WITH UPR SYSTEM AND LOW LVL CONVERGENCE ALONG ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT AND/OR SFC TROUGH EXTENDING NE INTO MO SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR SCTD DIURNAL STORMS. BACKED LOW LVL FLOW MAY YIELD A LOW TORNADO THREAT...BUT CLOUDINESS LIKELY WILL LIMIT OVERALL SVR POTENTIAL.

sections.title: ERN MT THIS AFTN AND EVE
sections.text: SCTD TSTMS SHOULD FORM THIS AFTN ALONG LEE TROUGH IN ERN MT...WHERE HEATING WILL BOOST SBCAPE TO AROUND 500 J/KG. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM ALONG/AHEAD OF COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH PREVIOUSLY MENTIONED UPR TROUGH. ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY WILL REMAIN MODEST...COMBINATION OF STEEP LOW LVL LAPSE RATES... STRENGTHENING/LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND FIELD...AND ASCENT WITH TROUGH SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLD STG WIND GUSTS AND/OR MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. ..CORFIDI/JIRAK.. 05/20/2010

sections.title: CNTRL/E TX INTO THE LWR MS/TN VLYS
sections.text: ARCING OUTFLOW CONTINUES TO PROGRESS SEWD ACROSS NWRN MS AND NRN LA. MULTI-BANDED TSTMS CONTINUE ALONG/AHEAD OF THE FEATURE ACROSS MIDDLE/WRN TN SWD INTO WRN AL/CNTRL MS AND NRN LA AMIDST FAVORABLE VERTICAL SHEAR TO SUPPORT MULTICELL/ISOLD SUPERCELL STORM MODES CAPABLE OF DMGG WINDS...LARGE HAIL AND BRIEF TORNADOES. FARTHER W...WITHIN COMPARATIVELY STEEPER MID-LVL LAPSE RATES/BUOYANCY...SUPERCELL STORMS WERE BACKBUILDING ALONG WRN EXTEND OF THE OUTFLOW/SEGMENTED CDFNT FROM NE-NCNTRL TX WHERE SRN EXTENT OF MODEST UPR FLOW/HEIGHT FALLS EXIST. LLVL FLOW IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...BUT VIGOROUS STRETCHING INVOF THE BOUNDARY HAS RESULTED IN BRIEF TORNADOES. OTHERWISE...VERY LARGE HAIL CAN BE EXPECTED.

sections.title: TX
sections.text: OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM THE LOWER MS VALLEY THROUGH N-CNTRL TX JUST NORTH OF WACO THEN WSWWD TO JUST S OF SAN ANGELO. WARM SECTOR IS STRONGLY UNSTABLE S OF THIS BOUNDARY WITH 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. STORMS CONTINUE BACKBUILDING WWD ALONG THE BOUNDARY WHERE ZONE OF STRONGER MESOSCALE ASCENT EXISTS IN ASSOCIATION WITH A WWD PROPAGATING GRAVITY WAVE INTERSECTING THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WIND AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO WILL PERSIST NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO UNDERGO A GRADUAL DECREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY BY LATE EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES.

sections.title: MO
sections.text: OCCLUDED FRONT EXTENDS FROM A SURFACE LOW IN NWRN MO SSWWD THROUGH SWRN MO. WARM FRONT EXTENDS SEWD FROM THE LOW THROUGH CNTRL AND SERN MO. SCATTERED STORMS INCLUDING A FEW MINI-SUPERCELLS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG OCCLUDED FRONT AND WITHIN ZONE OF DPVA ASSOCIATED WITH VORT MAX ROTATING THROUGH UPPER LOW. THREAT FOR AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO MAY PERSIST FOR ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS WITH GREATEST POTENTIAL ASSOCIATED WITH STORMS THAT LIFT NEWD AND INTERACT WITH THE WARM FRONT. THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH BY 03Z DUE TO A STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER.

sections.title: SRN MS AND AL
sections.text: STORMS CONTINUE DEVELOPING WITHIN ZONE OF LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS FROM ERN AL SWWD THROUGH SRN AL THEN WWD THROUGH SRN MS. THE MOST ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDE A LINE WITH ROTATING COMMA HEAD MOVING INTO SWRN MS THAT WILL MERGE WITH OTHER STORMS DEVELOPING NORTH OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. DAMAGING WIND IS POSSIBLE AS THIS LINE MOVES EWD THROUGH S CNTRL MS. OTHER STORMS APPEAR LESS ORGANIZED...AND MULTICELL IN CHARACTER. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL REMAINS POSSIBLE THROUGH ABOUT 03Z. HOWEVER...NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL RESULT IN A GRADUAL DECREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY.

sections.title: ERN OK THROUGH NWRN AR
sections.text: VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATED A ZONE OF ENHANCED CUMULUS DEVELOPING FROM PARTS OF ERN OK INTO NWRN AR ALONG AND EAST OF COLD FRONT. HOWEVER...THE LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE IN THE PROCESS OF VEERING AS PRIMARY LOW-LEVEL JET SHIFTS EWD THROUGH THE MID MS VALLEY IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE PROGRESSIVE UPPER LOW. NOCTURNAL COOLING...TENDENCY FOR THE LOW LEVEL WINDS TO VEER AHEAD OF FRONT AND LIKELIHOOD THAT DEEPER FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER LOW WILL REMAIN NORTH OF THIS REGION SUGGEST THE PROSPECTS FOR THUNDERSTORM INITIATION ARE BECOMING INCREASINGLY REMOTE. IF A STORM WERE TO DEVELOP...THE KINEMATIC AND THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT WOULD SUPPORT A THREAT FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. GIVEN THE CONDITIONAL NATURE OF THE THREAT...ONLY 5% SEVERE PROBABILITIES APPEAR WARRANTED. ..DIAL.. 05/21/2010
